newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Cash Grain PM - Basis bids little changed - May 13.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Cash Grain PM - Basis bids little changed - May 13.

text.p: Corn and soybean basis bids showed little movement Tuesday, and cash markets continued to find support from slow farmer sales, grain dealers said.
"It's pretty quiet, we're not buying much from the farmer, but we're not buying much, period," said one Kansas City-based merchandiser.
In some areas, periodic rains and cool temperatures have slowed planted efforts this week, merchandisers said.
"It has not been warm enough this week to dry out the fields," said a merchandiser in Toledo, Ohio. "Hopefully the guys are going to be back into the fields tomorrow."
In more western areas of the Corn Belt, planting progress was said to be advancing rapidly, crop watchers said.
"If the weather holds out until Friday, we'll have 90 percent of the corn planted in Iowa," said an Iowa State University crop specialist.
Basis values are quoted against CBOT futures, cash $/bu.

Note: UNQ=Unquoted. K=CBOT May, N=CBOT July
